name: CV (Loom-instantiated)
description: A narrative CV whose prose is written with {placeholder} expressions and instantiated at render time against a profile data file. Demonstrates Uniweb's foundation content handler hook with @uniweb/loom, the template-engine companion to Press. Ships with a single Charles Darwin profile containing publications, funding, teaching, service, and awards, and a Career Summary page with 17 Loom expressions that compute counts, totals, filters, and joins directly inside the authored markdown. Read the README for the pedagogical tour.
